summary: Iteration 3 testing complete for HRL Forge AI. Backend (11/11 pytest passing): NEW POST /api/v1/wiring/share (auth-gated) creates a share with an auto-generated 12-char token; unauthenticated create returns 401. GET /api/v1/wiring/share/{token} is public (no auth), returns the share and correctly increments view_count on each call (verified 0→1→2). Unknown token returns 404. POST /api/v1/auth/google with {session_id:'bogus'} returns 401 with detail 'Invalid or expired session_id' (Emergent /session-data called). Missing session_id returns 422. Regression smoke passed: auth/register+login, /boards (8), /templates (8), /sensors (8), /modules, /projects, /history. Frontend: /login shows google-signin-btn labelled 'Sign in with Google', /register shows 'Sign up with Google'. Clicking the button navigates to https://auth.emergentagent.com/oauth/?redirect=<origin>/auth/callback (Emergent 302s from '/' to '/oauth/'). AuthCallback route at /auth/callback#session_id=bogus shows the 'Finalizing sign-in…' state, POSTs to /auth/google, receives 401, and redirects to /login as expected. Wiring Generator: lib-tab-sensors default active with 8 sensors; clicking lib-item-dht22 creates selected-dht22 chip AND auto-populates prompt with 'Wire up these components: DHT22 Temp/Humidity. Provide pin mapping, wiring notes and BOM.'; switching to lib-tab-modules and clicking lib-item-oled-ssd1306 creates selected-oled-ssd1306 chip; X button on selected-dht22 removes the chip. share-wiring-btn is HIDDEN before any generation (connections.length==0), including after only library additions — confirmed. Public /share/wiring/{token} page renders without auth: share-title ('Arduino Uno R3'), share-view-count ('2 views'), share-tab-diagram/mapping/bom/notes and share-copy-link-btn all present; no redirect to /login. Sidebar nav (dashboard/workspace/wiring/projects/templates/boards/assistant/history/settings/docs) renders correctly (confirmed visually and in code — a brief query timing race gave a false-missing readout that did not reproduce visually).
critical_code_review_comments: wiring_router.get_share does a find_one THEN a separate update_one $inc — two round-trips per public view. Consider MongoDB find_one_and_update with return_document=AFTER to atomically increment and read in a single op (also removes the manual doc['view_count']+=1 fudge).
auth_router.google_auth performs a follow-up find_one after update_one to refetch the user — could use find_one_and_update with return_document=AFTER for a single round-trip.

SharedWiring.jsx hardcodes /api/v1/wiring/share/{token} via BACKEND_URL directly (bypasses the shared axios instance in @/lib/api). This is intentional (no auth) and fine, but note that error handling only checks 404 vs generic — a 500 will render as generic 'Failed to load'.
ComponentLibrary useEffect has an empty dep array and no error handling on the Promise.all fetch — a failure silently leaves the picker empty. Consider a try/catch with a toast or inline error state.

GoogleButton uses a full-page navigation via window.location.href — good, no history pollution. The AuthCallback replaces the fragment before hydrating auth state — nice touch to avoid leaking session_id in browser history.
WiringShare model auto-generates token as first 12 chars of uuid.hex — collision risk is extremely low but non-zero; a unique index on `token` in Mongo would provide durable safety.

AppShell nav is stable but the initial render race meant a query-selector immediately after register found no nav-* items; consider adding a subtle 'ready' marker (e.g. data-app-ready on sidebar) to help E2E tests avoid flakes.

rca of the issue: No blocking issues found. One minor observation: the Emergent Google auth landing URL 302-redirects from '/' to '/oauth/', so E2E tests should assert on host+redirect param, not on a specific path. Reproduction: navigate to /register, click google-signin-btn → observe URL becomes https://auth.emergentagent.com/oauth/?redirect=<encoded>.
